## Install / Update

Install the `dsh-plugins-git-sync` plugin on DeepSeek Harness with the released npm package:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugins-git-sync@latest
```

Update it:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-plugins-git-sync@latest
```
